title: First Brands Rushes to Stem Panic as Loan Plunges Below 60 Cents
content: Major investors in First Brands Group have offloaded stakes in the bankrupt auto supplier’s debt in recent days, causing the value of its most senior loan to collapse and prompting it to pull forward a lender call to calm nerves.

title: China Vanke Aims to Avoid Default as Creditor Meeting Kicks Off
content: China Vanke Co. creditors are set to meet Wednesday as the distressed developer makes one more push to win support for a bond extension plan aimed at averting a default.

title: Allspring Global CEO on Launching ETFs, Private Credit
content: Kate Burke, CEO of Allspring Global Investments, says most individual investors will continue to keep the bulk of their allocations in public markets. She tells Romaine Bostick and Katie Greifeld on “The Close” that Allspring is focused on strengthening its core investment teams rather than chasing new areas. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Slump of DATs, Crypto's Influence on Trump: David Bailey
